items.title: Bernard Purdie interviewed by Monk Rowe, West Orange, New Jersey, July 30, 2003
items.q: Well I did so many dates and things with each one of them

ctx.x: Oh yeah, I forgot about him.

Well I did so many dates and things with each one of them and Paul Griffin of course we were together with Steely Dan. Larry Carlton, Paul Griffin, Chuck Rainey. I mean you’re talking about the cream of the crop of musicians who could play anything but played what was necessary for what was asked of them at the time. See that’s the beauty. That to me is what it’s about. That’s why I can go anyplace anywhere in the world and play with anybody. Because I know the rhythms. It’s that simple. And you’ve just got to…
It sounds simple. It takes talent that’s for sure.
